name: lifeflow-personal-hub
description: LifeFlow personal management hub for Android

scripts.build: tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.cjs -i styles/tailwind.css -o lifeflow.generated.css --minify && node scripts/copy-web-assets.mjs && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run build && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
